newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smithfield raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smithfield raised to buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she raised her rating on Smithfield Foods Inc to a buy from neutral, mainly on price.
-- Her earnings estimate for the first quarter was raised to $0.25 from from $0.20, compared with $0.02 a year ago. She decreased her third quarter estimate to $1.25 from $1.30, compared with $0.82.
-- Her fiscal 1998 estimate is unchanged at $3.10, compared with $2.34 a year ago.

-- "We believe that Smithfield's first quarter, which ended in July, shaped up pretty much like its fourth fiscal 1997 quarter -- tough results in fresh pork, but good results in its processing and pork production operations," Wittenburg said in a report. "Therefore, we're fine tuning our 1998 quarterly estimates a little, although our full-year estimate remains the same."
